the thermoelectric effects are very strong, and that the thermoelectromotive forces can be very large in quantum wires and in quantum dots.

the non-linear thermoelectric effects are very sensitive to the temperature and the coupling strength of a quantum dot to its leads.
the thermopower can be tuned by the chemical potential, the temperature gradient and the coupling of the quantum dot to its contacts, which is important for the application of thermoelectric devices.
